articles.title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
articles.snippet: Payward agreed to buy Lithuania’s Saldo Bank, which holds $190 million in total assets, securing an EU license for deposits and lending.

articles.title: Dutch central bank grants Qivalis e-money license for MiCA-compliant euro token
articles.snippet: Backed by BBVA, BNP Paribas, and ING, Qivalis secured Dutch regulatory authorization to offer onchain euro settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin climbs toward $84,000 after Fed’s Williams sees no rate hikes in 2027
articles.snippet: ZEC led a broad bounce among major tokens, and Korean chipmakers snapped a five-day losing streak ahead of Thursday’s U.S. inflation data.

articles.title: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
articles.snippet: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized 112 servers and shut down 241 websites linked to investment scams that targeted Russian-speaking Americans.

articles.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as transaction volumes grow
articles.snippet: The bank identified four distinct stablecoin markets, with USDC leading payments and AI transactions as competition intensifies over reserve yields.
